status: PREDECLARED before any real-data run; committed and pushed first. Structural validation only: coverage, quality states, refusals, PIT, determinism. No outcome, P&L, Sharpe, profit factor, win rate, predictive power or ranking is computed.
scope_rule: 2026-10-04 strictly after the W3 end (partial) and 2026-10-05 (full). The active day 2026-10-06 is never read beyond the spill-over hour certified by the 2026-10-05 seal. A further sealed day is reported, not used, unless separately verified and the purpose is unchanged.

sources.B: the live dataset's sealed files for exactly the same paths (byte-identical to A, else STOP); the growing active-day manifest is replaced by the sealed snapshot from the 2026-10-05 backup

offgrid_pit_probe_rationale: 30 s after a 15m bar close, before the candle fetch (steady-state lag up to 164 s): the just-closed bar is CLOSED but NOT YET AVAILABLE, so the poison counterfactual (that bar replaced by an absurd later fetch) exercises the candle availability guard on real data; snapshots there are expected to be STALE_INPUT. Chosen by calendar only.
decision_time_rationale: grid-15m-plus390s-v1 points: the first post-W3 grid point (no history: exercises INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY), every few hours, both sides of the 2026-10-05 00:10:10Z universe transition, and the last grid point of each day. Chosen by calendar only.
equity_curve: none on real data (drawdown must be UNAVAILABLE(no_equity_curve_supplied)); the drawdown engine is validated on synthetic paths only

checks.coverage: per snapshot and metric: state counts, null reasons, fixture refusals
checks.pit_truncation: for every T: snapshots from a state truncated to available_at <= T (books, depth, confirmation boundaries, candles, health, lifecycle, clock, gaps, epochs) must be byte-identical
checks.pit_poison: for every T: future records replaced or injected with absurd values (books, depth ladders, candles incl. BTC, a late-announced and a future universe epoch, DEGRADED health, a connection event, a gap) must leave every snapshot byte-identical
checks.determinism: two runs from source A and one from source B: identical logical hash and byte-identical files
checks.reference: independent reference implementation (statistics module, fractions) for gross, net, largest share, top-3, HHI, effective N, sigma, pairwise correlation, beta and portfolio sigma; max abs difference <= 1e-9 (relative for currency values)
checks.pass: 0 PIT violations, 0 determinism differences, 0 reference differences beyond tolerance

stop_conditions: resource violation (envelope: systemd-run scope CPUQuota=100% MemoryMax=2G, nice 15, ionice c3, prlimit 2 GiB)
